summary: Apparatus chunks with verified tags: 35 Orphic Hymns Taylor Dissertation + 9 others carry 234 accepted concept tags and 579 live edges on editorial/prophylon front-matter

analysis.author: corpus-quality
analysis.content:
SWEPT 2026-08-20 across all 6068 chunk TOML bodies in corpus/ + data/guru.db. Found 44 apparatus chunks carrying verified concept tags:

ORPHIC HYMNS (Thomas Taylor edition) — 35 chunks:
greek_mystery.orphic-hymns.002 through 034 (33 chunks), plus .087 and .138
All have section='Front Matter' — these are Taylor's 'Dissertation on the Life and Theology of Orpheus' editorial commentary, not the actual hymns.
- 209 accepted (verified) concept tags across these chunks
- 507 live edges (EXPRESSES + PARALLELS) sourced from these chunks
- Orphic-hymns.002 alone: 4 accepted tags, section='Front Matter, p. 2 (part 1)', body starts 'PREFACE.'
- Orphic-hymns.007: 7 accepted tags, 8 EXPRESSES edges, 1 PARALLELS edge
- Orphic-hymns.017: 21 accepted tags, 23 EXPRESSES edges
- Orphic-hymns.034: 8 accepted tags, 21 EXPRESSES edges

OTHER TEXTS with apparatus+verified-tags:
- hermeticism.corpus-hermeticum-14.003: 9 accepted tags, 16 EXPRESSES edges (footnote block)
- egyptian.egyptian-heaven-and-hell.002: 2 accepted tags, 5 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- western_esoteric.tarot-of-the-bohemians.001: 5 accepted tags, 5 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- western_esoteric.book-of-ceremonial-magic.004: 4 accepted tags, 4 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- western_esoteric.secret-teachings-of-all-ages.263: 2 accepted tags, 2 EXPRESSES edges (editorial)
- western_esoteric.secret-teachings-of-all-ages.382: 1 accepted tag, 1 EXPRESSES edge (footnote)
- western_esoteric.tertium-organum.002: 2 accepted tags, 2 EXPRESSES edges (preface)
- egyptian.egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index.002: 0 accepted, 1 pending (preface)
- egyptian.egyptian-book-of-the-dead-index.003: 0 accepted, 1 pending (preface)

OVERLAP: This is a sub-scope of ticket 50438e23 (which specifically called out orphic-hymns Taylor Dissertation but only as one of many apparatus-leak sources). This ticket captures the verified-tag contamination — the most dangerous aspect — which 50438e23's analysis did not quantify.
